title: Περὶ αἰτιῶν καὶ σημείων / Θεραπευτικὸν ὀξέων καὶ χρονίων παθῶν — On the Causes and Signs, and the Therapy, of Acute and Chronic Diseases; RU: Аретей, «О причинах и признаках острых и хронических болезней»
author: Aretaeus of Cappadocia
edition: Hude, CMG II, 1923 (2nd ed. 1958), free online: http://cmg.bbaw.de/epubl/online/cmg_02.html. Adams 1856 Greek text is public domain.
ru_evidence: The detailed ru.wikipedia «Аретей из Каппадокии» tabulates 12 editions and translations (Latin, German, English, French), none Russian.
en_evidence: Adams, London 1856 (Sydenham Society), complete, public domain.
other_translations: German: Dewez 1790–1803, Mann 1858. French: Laennec/Grmek 2000 (Causes and Signs).
value: A literary masterpiece of Greek medicine with classic descriptions of diabetes, coeliac disease, asthma, migraine, tetanus, and mania and melancholy. Ideal for students and historians of medicine and psychiatry; Russian readers have no version at all.
ai_feasibility: high: coherent descriptive prose; Ionic forms are manageable; Adams and Hude's apparatus serve for cross-checking, not as a base.
pilot_unit: Causes and Signs of Chronic Diseases, Book I (mania, melancholy, epilepsy) and II.2 (diabetes), est. 10–12k words
